concerns.text: Tasks T018a, T018, T019b, and T020 implement a Block Bootstrap deviation test against theoretical error bounds, explicitly rejecting the Chi-squared test. This violates FR-003 and FR-004 in spec.md which mandate a 'Chi-squared (χ²) goodness-of-fit test' with 'exact test or Monte Carlo simulation' fallback. The tasks silently replace the required statistical method with a different methodology defined in plan.md, weakening the FRs.

Task T027a instructs to 'define constants... as hard-coded placeholders' if not found in data-model.md/research.md. This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and the Plan's requirement to use specific formulas from Lebowitz-Lockard (2021) and Pollack & Roy (2024). Allowing placeholders without a verification mechanism risks using unverified constants, violating the 'Verified Accuracy' gate.

Task T020 defines the theoretical expectation E_k^theo as 'error-bound-adjusted' but the task description for T018 explicitly states 'Calculate expected counts E_k = N/p'. The tasks fail to clearly define how the 'error-bound-adjusted' expectation is derived from the cited literature (Lebowitz-Lockard/Pollack & Roy) as required by the Plan, creating a semantic gap between the FR-003 requirement for a specific test and the implementation logic.

Task T019b implements a 'Primary Deviation Test' comparing D_obs against a bootstrap distribution. This replaces the 'Chi-squared test statistic' required by FR-004. The task does not include a step to calculate or report the χ² statistic, meaning the deliverable falls short of the FR-004 requirement to 'generate a visualization report containing the χ² test statistic'.
